description: This file defines the 'Comment' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's catalog module, specifically handling CMS comment-related functionalities such as listing comments, replying, adding comments, and managing comment rates within the 'cms/comment' section.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class managing CMS comments for the catalog module, including listing, replying to, adding comments, and handling comment ratings within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to load the comment page; initializes language settings, manages filtering, sorting, pagination, and loads comment data for display.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of comments (likely for AJAX or API use) by rendering the 'cms/comment' view with comment data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Handles retrieval of comments, including filtering by article ID, sorting, pagination, and assembling comment data for display.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Fetches replies to a specific comment, handling pagination, and returns a view with nested comment replies.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Loads the reply view for a comment, including nested reply threads.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a new comment, including validation, spam check, captcha verification, and saving comment data.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Handles rating (like/dislike) for a comment, including validation, updating ratings, and returning JSON response.
